How the shiny odds are assigned

These are community guide rates, not official Pokémon GO odds. A species or event can have a different rate; check the source before spending passes or incubators.

1/10 Raid Day: only the named featured raid boss during that event’s hours. Generic raid events and Raid Hours do not receive this rate.

Shiny locked: the feed marks that Pokémon as unavailable in that encounter. Where the source does not report shiny availability, the card says unverified.

Times appear in your iPhone’s local time. Tap Add to Calendar to save an event with a 30-minute alert. View PoGO Calendar ↗
